sloka: क्रतुं समाप्य तु तदा न्यायतः पुरुषर्षभः ।ऋत्विग्भ्यो हि ददौ राजा धराम् ताम् कुलवर्धनः ॥१-१४-४५॥
transliteration: kratuṁ samāpya tu tadā nyāyataḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ ।ṛtvigbhyo hi dadau rājā dharām tām kulavardhanaḥ ॥1-14-45॥

translations.english: "O ruler of the earth We are constantly engaged in the study of the Vedas. We are not capable of ruling the earth and we cannot do anything with its possession. Give some other charity in lieu of that.
translations.hindi: यह्‌ सुन द्विजपुङ्गव वसिष्ठ जी ने दशरथ जी से कहा--आपके कथनानुसार ही हम सब कार्य करेंगे
